title: Chapter 461
paragraphs: Chapter 461
Episode 131. People with good intuition, people with bad intuition (5)
"But the voice wasn't Bubar's."
It wasn't the suffocating, petty voice unique to Bubar, which felt like it was clogged with a lump of grease, nor was it his characteristic irritable tone.
It was a clear yet furious, lowered female voice.
"It wasn't Marjiella's voice either. Then who could it be?"
Someone else from Kinzelo? Or Amella?
At the moment the doubt arose, a massive, dull sphere gathered in Bubar's open mouth.

Suddenly formed Bubar and the breath, the members of the great power were not flustered and spread a protective shield. Being elite who were immune to some kind of mental attack, they maintained their composure even in the face of a first-time experience.
Ooong-!
Bubar's breath expanded rapidly, creating an intense noise as if it would explode at any moment.
Even a rough estimate revealed that an immense energy was about to be unleashed.
Just before the breath burst, the protective shield of the great powers flashed brightly. The first place the unleashed breath reached was where the Rune Kandel members were positioned.
"Haah!"
A man standing at the forefront of the Rune Kandel camp let out a loud, vigorous shout.
It seemed as if the shout alone had cut the breath in half. The breath was split in two even before the sound echoed, but in reality, it was the man's sword that had struck down.
Uniquely for Rune Kandel, he used a sword and shield as his main weapons, and he emitted an enormous energy every time he exerted himself.
'Rune Kandel sent Vugo, huh.'
Vugo Rune Kandel, the fourth son of Siron and the sixth generation of the family. Behind him were guardian knights and two execution knights spreading a protective shield.
'I thought Joshua would come in person, does he have other business?'
As Amella was one of the few remaining major neutral forces, they had expected the top generation of the family to come.
Someone from the 1st to 4th generation, in other words, someone from the top
generations was expected to come.
Vugo was by no means an inadequate figure, but given the circumstances, the enemies must have sent someone equivalent to Rune Kandel's top generation.
However, when he turned his gaze to the Ziple camp, he realized that they also hadn't sent their top generation.
'Midor Elner...?'
His face was the first to be confirmed. As the breath that was hitting Rune Kandel suddenly bent towards the Ziple side, other members were obscured, but there seemed to be no one of higher status.
Kellick Ziple's illegitimate child and the person who came to save Myron Ziple during the Colon native massacre. He owed him a debt.
It was almost the end of Colon because of the 'spatial explosion' power of Kellick he had shown at that time.
Crack!
That day came to mind, and he reflexively gritted his teeth.
Although it was quite a struggle, ultimately Midor had helped him. Thanks to that, he learned that Kellick could 'divide' space.
Kinjello and the Royal forces were also examined.
Excluding the giant figure of Bubbar, Kinjello also had no executives that Jin knew of.
The royal forces seemed to be composed only of the Special Task Force and the Royal Guard, with all their faces covered.
Although Hiran could not participate due to recent terror and political pressure, at least the leaders of the empire's top families or those equivalent should have come, but only the members came.
Of course, the members of each faction in the Gaipa region now were those who could boast of their power anywhere in the world.
However, there was a definite lack of representation for the four major forces to properly fight for power.
[Hey, kid. Didn't you say I would need my halo?]
Murakan spoke.
Now Bubbar's breath was heading towards the royal forces after hitting Kinjello, and Murakan even sneered at the sight.

[Wow. What a toy spinning doll? It's my first time seeing such a breath being vomited like that. It's also funny how it gets weaker every time it collides. Anyway, there seems to be no one who needs something like my halo. It's unfortunate, but honestly, you're doing better than them, right?]
"How dare they compare themselves to my lord."
[At first, you were just giving me snake eyes, but you seem to have quite a talent for flattery.]
"Thank you, Murakan. But in my opinion... the people who should have come here seem to be gathered somewhere else."
At Lata's words, Jin nodded.
Jin had come to the same conclusion.
'There is a much bigger issue than Amella, one that I don't know...!'
Otherwise, there was no reason for only people like Vugo to gather here.
He couldn't immediately think of what the other issue was that had to be seized even at the expense of giving up Amella.
He also felt like he had been hit hard in the back of the head.
[What? Where are the people who should be here gathered?]
"They say there is something more important than Amella. I have no idea what it is at the moment."
[So, did you get tricked? Before even starting anything here in the Gaipa region?]
In the meantime, the giant Bubbar was gathering his breath again.
"It's not necessarily like that."
[Why?]
"Since lower-tier competitors have come, we can quickly finish things here and go where they are."
[That's if no one else has taken something more important than Amella by then.]
"That's a matter of luck. But our luck hasn't been bad lately, has it?"
When he fired the first breath, and even now as he prepared a new breath, the giant Bubbar moved very slowly.
Despite this, each faction could not respond quickly to the giant Bubbar's actions.
They couldn't counterattack properly either. The warriors shot sword energy from their positions, and the wizards cast long-range attack magic, but most of them had lower power than their levels.
Most of them seemed unable to fully demonstrate their abilities due to some interference. Among them, outstanding individuals like V
ugo and the executioners protected those who couldn't.
Moreover, the factions hadn't even noticed Murakan and his party floating in the sky yet.
Dusty clouds rose madly as the stale energy, breath, and protective shields collided, and the outstanding individuals were completely preoccupied with protecting their members.
"My lord, except for a few people, everyone is moving as if they're intoxicated by a nerve poison."
"It must be due to the black energy that's proliferating. Like the ones we saw on the island earlier, it makes anyone below 7 stars go completely insane."
Lata and Faye spoke.
"Lata, do you still think it's not poison or a hallucinogen?"

"Yes, my lord. I judged earlier that there was no lingering scent, but considering the scale and color, if it were a poison, there must be a smell that would inevitably drift. There are only a limited number of poisonous plants with such a color."
Murakan was lowering his flight altitude while circling around the black energy.
Since Jin's party hadn't been exposed to the other factions yet, it was best to hide their presence as much as possible for as long as possible.
However, as they got closer to the stale energy spreading from the giant Bubbar, something began to change in the Prochi siblings.
"Ugh!"
"My lord...!"
Lata and Faye suddenly clutched their heads. They even let go of Murakan's scales, which they had been holding onto, and groaned in pain.
Although they had put up a protective shield in case they got close to the stale energy, it seemed to be of no use.
"Lata!? Faye?"
Jin caught the two who were about to fall.
Only a few seconds had passed since they got closer to the stale energy, but the Prochi siblings were pale and sweating as if it were raining.
"Get a hold of yourselves!"
[Hey, hey. What's wrong with you guys all of a sudden?]
"Murakan! Get out of the stale energy first... Huh!"
Whiz! Swoosh!
Something sharp grazed Jin's coat collar.
It had only slightly cut the front of the collar because Jin had reacted quickly and dodged. It was originally a fingernail aimed at his neck.
It was Faye's fingernail.
In Jin's widened eyes, he saw Faye's skin color changing.
Her skin, which had changed without him realizing, had a color similar to the stale energy of the giant Bubbar.
And then, Faye lowered her head with all her strength one last time.
It was an action intended to convey that it wasn't her will, and with that as the last thing, Faye completely lost her sanity.
"Kyaa!"
The moment Faye attacked again, Jin threw a punch to knock her unconscious.
His fist connected with her jaw, but Faye continued to attack as if she hadn't been hit at all.
And next to her, Lata was bending his body and shivering. He couldn't hold onto Murakan's scales anymore.
He was exerting all his strength to resist the stale energy that was contaminating his mind until the very end. Since Lata had a higher achievement than Faye, he was resisting a little more.
But it looked precarious, like a thread that could break at any moment.
"Ugh... My, my lord...!"
"Lata!"
"Something, in my head!"
At that moment, Murakan ascended and escaped the stale energy.
[Ha! What's this? Kid, do they seem to be regaining their sanity?]
At the same time, Lata and Faye's eyes and skin color returned to normal, but the siblings seemed to be still in shock, breathing heavily.
'What is that stale energy? Why does it only affect Lata and Faye? It completely ignored the protective shield.'
As the Prochi siblings said, it wasn't poison. The antidote bead in their body wasn't reacting at all.
But the stale energy was showing effects almost similar to poison or an indescribably powerful drug or hallucinogen.

The members of the giant faction were also struggling with the stale energy, so it wasn't just a special reaction for the Prochi siblings. Even the most outstanding individuals from each faction were not 'completely' free from the stale energy.
In other words, Jin and Murakan were the only ones unaffected by the stale energy in the entire Gaipa Army.
'It affects everyone in the world, but it can't harm me and Murakan.'
A word suddenly came to mind.
'Curse!'
That's right.
The stale energy covering the entire island was the energy of a curse. That was the reason why only Jin and Murakan, the contractors of Soldelet and the Black Dragon, were unaffected.
'If I evacuate Lata and Faye, I'll have the advantage over all factions, even if I move alone in this situation.'
Just as he was about to tell Murakan to fly to another island,
[Ah, what is this? Suddenly.]
Suddenly, tentacle-like stale energy stretched out from Bubbar. Murakan easily dodged the stale energy.
The Lata siblings jumped into the stale energy like people possessed by ghosts.
Then, the tentacle-like stale energy transformed like a cradle, wrapping around the siblings and drawing them inside.
